title: Quick check: Dynamic UI and Live Regions

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “Dynamic UI and Live Regions”?
options: Loading announcements should use semantics and focus/keyboard behavior that assistive technology can observe.
The concept removes the need to consider error states or accessibility.
The browser will infer all application behavior even if inputs and state are contradictory.
The concept allows application code to mutate React-managed DOM and state directly.
questions.answer_key: Loading announcements should use semantics and focus/keyboard behavior that assistive technology can observe.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Dynamic UI and Live Regions: Loading announcements should use semantics and focus/keyboard behavior that assistive technology can observe.

questions.prompt: Which practice is most reliable when applying Loading announcements?
options: Skip validation because a successful render proves that the application is correct.
Store duplicate copies of every value so each component can change it independently.
Optimize by adding every available Hook without measuring the result.
Test keyboard use, accessible names, focus order, and semantic controls.
questions.answer_key: Test keyboard use, accessible names, focus order, and semantic controls.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Dynamic UI and Live Regions: Test keyboard use, accessible names, focus order, and semantic controls.

questions.prompt: What should you verify before considering “Dynamic UI and Live Regions” complete?
options: Assume a client-side check proves that a remote service accepted the change.
Rely only on a screenshot of the happy path and never repeat the test.
Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
Check only whether the file exists; syntax and runtime behavior do not matter.
questions.answer_key: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Dynamic UI and Live Regions: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
